prs.tagLine: A Renaissance for Rented Apartment Living
prs.location:
At Seafield Strand, you get the best of all worlds. Commuting is a breeze thanks to easy access to key transport links like the M1, M50, Sutton train station, Dublin Airport and Dublin bus routes. And when you need to escape the hustle and bustle of the city, there’s Seafield Strand beach and Howth Hill cliff walk right on your doorstep.

The development is enviably positioned with a host of local amenities just a gentle stroll away. You can work up a sweat at Sutton Golf Club, Binn Eadair GAA or the Suttonions Rugby Club. Then unwind with a sweet treat or freshly brewed coffee at the local Starbucks, Insomnia or Minetta Delicatessen.

Experience a lifestyle beyond compare, where luxury, comfort, and breathtaking natural beauty unite. Unrivalled transport connections through the DART and Dublin Bus networks ensure you’re effortlessly connected to the city while revelling in the oasis you call home.

description:
Discover a new horizon in luxury rental accommodation at Seafield Strand.

Nestled in the tranquil coastal surroundings of Sutton, Seafield Strand is home to meticulously crafted 1, 2 and 3 bedroom standard, duplex and penthouse apartments. Our luxury rental accommodation is designed to envelop you in comfort, elevate your lifestyle and offer a haven of serenity. Located a stone’s throw from the heart of Sutton village and the stunning Sutton Strand, Seafield Strand is where modern convenience meets tranquil sanctuary. It’s a place to live that’s truly unrivalled.
